column12: COMPOSITIONS FOR CANCER THERAPEUTICS

column12: SUSTAINED RELEASE FORMULATIONS USING NON-AQUEOUS MEMBRANE EMULSIFICATION
column13: Non-aqueous membrane emulsion methods for producing polymeric and polymer-coated microparticles are provided. Some embodiments provide methods for producing a sustained release or controlled release microparticle by combining micronized protein powder and a polymer into a hydrocarbon solvent to form a non-aqueous first solution, agitating the first non-aqueous solution to form a suspension, feeding the suspension into a dispersion pump, wherein the suspension is infused through a porous membrane into a continuous phase comprising a fluorocarbon liquid and a fluorosurfactant to form a hydrocarbon-in-fluorocarbon emulsion. The hydrocarbon solvent, the fluorocarbon liquid, and the fluorosurfactant are removed, and the microparticles are collected.

column12: MICROEMULSION SYSTEMS FOR THE INCORPORATION OF POORLY-WATER SOLUBLE COMPOUNDS INTO BACTERIAL CELLULOSE
column13: The present invention relates to a fiber-layer patch comprising or consisting of a) a bacterial cellulose layer, and b) an oil-in-water microemulsion or water-in-oil microemulsion, each comprising or consisting of at least one surfactant, at least one co-surfactant, at least one oil, water, optionally at least one additive, and at least one active ingredient. Furthermore, the present invention pertains to a method for manufacturing the patch according to the invention, wherein said is obtained by absorption loading comprising the following steps: I) providing and optionally squeezing a never-dried patch of bacterial cellulose, II) inserting the never-dried and optionally squeezed patch of bacterial cellulose into a container containing the microemulsion so that the bacterial cellulose is fully covered with the microemulsion, III) stirring the microemulsion which contains the patch of bacterial cellulose for at least 48h. Finally, the present invention refers to the use of the patch according to the present invention for wound healing, drug delivery, skin care, aesthetic treatments and tissue regeneration.

column12: SOLID STATE ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL COMPOSITIONS FOR TRANSDERMAL DRUG DELIVERY
column13: Transdermal drug delivery systems and methods of fabricating such systems for the delivery of an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) are provided. The active pharmaceutical ingredient shall have an unfavorable water solubility of less than about 10 milligrams per milliliter, an unfavorable melting point greater than about 120°C, and a log P value ranging from about -2 to about 8. More particularly, the present disclosure is directed to improving the permeation of such compounds through the skin by forming a solid-state particulate including the drug (API) and polyvinylpyrrolidone that is complexed, solvated, processed, micronized and incorporated into an adhesive layer to maintain a solid-state suspension of glass-like particulates.

column12: Drug conjugated nanogels in microcapsule for delayed sustained protein delivery
column13: Injectable compositions and use of the injectable compositions in tissue engineering applications are described. The injectable compositions are hydrogel-based compositions that can be crosslinked in situ following placement. The injectable compositions include microcapsules having predetermined erosion profiles that are loaded with nanogels having predetermined sustained release profiles for signaling molecules conjugated to the nanogels. Following crosslinking, the compositions are designed to sequentially release signaling molecules over a predetermined period of time with various release profiles. The compositions can carry additional components to stimulate tissue generation such as stem cells and extracellular matrix (ECM) components.

column12: Ultraviolet polymerization hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a method for preparing PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel through ultraviolet radiation and performance research of the PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel. According to the hydrogel, polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) is used as a monomer, a novel water-soluble photoinitiator PyBN is used as an initiator, free radical crosslinking reaction is initiated through 365nm ultraviolet light irradiation, and the hydrogel with excellent mechanical property and controllable swelling behavior is formed. Experimental results show that compared with hydrogel prepared by a traditional photoinitiator 1173, the PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel has higher elasticity and strain capacity, is lower in cross-linked network density and can bear larger compression amount. Besides, the swelling ratio of the hydrogel in deionized water at 25 DEG C is only 110.9%, and the hydrogel shows good dimensional stability and swelling controllability and is suitable for the field of biological medicine. The hydrogel provided by the invention is simple in preparation method, PyBN is applied to hydrogel crosslinking for the first time as a pyrrolo-pyrrole structure photoinitiator, and a new idea is provided for developing a high-performance water-soluble photoinitiator and functional hydrogel. The hydrogel has wide application prospects in the fields of drug sustained release, cell culture, biosensors and the like.

column12: Polyethylene glycol derivative, preparation method thereof, and polyethylene glycol hydrogel capable of producing a rapid crosslinking reaction
column13: The present invention provides a polyethylene glycol derivative comprising a repeat unit having the structure of Formula (I) and a terminal group having the structure of Formula (II). The polyethylene glycol derivative provided by the present invention has good biocompatibility, due to the repeat unit having the structure of Formula (I); and can react with various groups such as amino, (acyl)hydrazino, and aminooxy with a fast reaction rate under mild reaction conditions, due to the o-phthalaldehyde terminal group having the structure of Formula (II). The polyethylene glycol derivative provided by the present invention is mixed with polyethylene glycol having an amino-containing terminal group in an aqueous medium, to rapidly form a chemically cross-linked hydrogel material. The hydrogel material has mild preparation conditions, fast gel-forming speed, high mechanical strength, and good stability. This polyethylene glycol hydrogel can be applied as drug sustained-release carrier, tissue engineering scaffold, etc. in the field of biomedical materials.

The nano vaccine comprises a polymer nano assembly and a drug, wherein the polymer nano assembly comprises an amphiphilic polymer and cationic liposome co-assembly; the amphiphilic polymer comprises a polyethylene glycol-polyphosphate segmented copolymer; the medicine comprises an immunologic adjuvant. The nano vaccine provided by the invention not only can be used for in-situ capture of tumor antigens, but also can carry antigens and immune agonists and deliver the antigens and immune agonists to tumor drainage lymph nodes in a targeted manner by utilizing the advantage of small size, so that the maturation of dendritic cells is promoted, the mature dendritic cells process the antigens and present the antigens to T cells, and CD8 + T cells are activated; and a strong anti-tumor immune response is induced.

column12: Sustained-release antibacterial film and preparation method thereof

column12: Photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material and its composition, preparation method, use, product, and preparation kit
column13: This invention provides a preparation, composition, product, and application of a photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material. The preparation includes dissolving Component A including a photosensitive polymer derivative having o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers and Component B including a polymer derivative having amine or alkene (double group) or sulfhydryl group in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A and solution B, respectively; mixing the solution A and solution B homogeneously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; initiating photo-coupled synergistic crosslinking under an irradiation of a UV light to form the hydrogel. The irradiation causes the o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers to generate an aldehyde group/keto group or a nitroso group to initiate photo-coupled synergetic crosslinking. The photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel has applications in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing and as a carrier of cell, protein or drug.

column12: PH responsive polymer nano-micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a pH responsive polymer nano-micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The pH-responsive polymer nano-micelle based on a polyethylene glycol unit and a diisopropylamino unit forms a compact nano-micelle protection perfume in the storage process, fundamentally solves the problem of poor stability of the perfume, and when the pH value is lower than the critical pH value, the stability of the perfume is greatly improved due to the accurate switching performance in the use process. The effect of controlling the release of the perfume is achieved through the depolymerization of the compact nano-micelles; meanwhile, the perfuming agent has excellent universality, meets the requirement for precise release of different perfumes under different environmental conditions, and is suitable for various perfuming products such as hydrophilic daily cosmetics, cleaning products and indoor air fresheners. Compared with the prior art, the amphiphilic block polymer has the advantages that the stability and the selectivity of the amphiphilic block polymer are improved, and the high sensitivity and the precise controlled release performance of the amphiphilic block polymer as a nano-micelle are also improved.

column12: Device for sustained controlled release of therapeutically active substances and use thereof
column13: A device (7) for sustained controlled release of a therapeutically active substance after implantation of the device alone or in combination with a further implantable element (1, 3), the device (7) comprising a material layer (8) containing at least one therapeutically active substance, wherein the layer (8) comprises a biodegradable matrix consisting of a mixture of: 60% to 95% by dry weight of a first component (A) in the form of a copolymer of DL-lactide and glycolide (PLGA), with the molar ratio of DL-lactide to glycolide being in the range of 40: 60 to 60: 40, and the weight average molecular weight (MWw) of the first component (A) being in the range of 100,000 to 150,000 g/mol; and 5% to 40%, by dry weight, of a second component (B) in the form of polyethylene glycol (PEG), the dry weight of component (A) and component (B) being supplemented to 100% of the matrix in which the at least one therapeutically active substance is dissolved and/or suspended.

column12: Acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticles adaptive to pancreatic cancer and preparation method of acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticles
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano drug loading, and particularly relates to an acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticle adaptive to pancreatic cancer and a preparation method of the acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticle. According to the polyphenol polymer disclosed by the invention, a biodegradable polyethylene glycol (PEG) polyphenol polymer is used as a skeleton, and then a hydrophobic drug improved gemcitabine and leflunomide are entrapped by using a metal ion chelation effect to form nanoparticles. The nanoparticles can respond to a special environment in tumor cells to release improved gemcitabine and leflunomide, can induce cell ferroptosis by regulating and controlling pancreatic tumor cell mitochondrial metabolism, can induce mitochondrial exocytosis to realize deep drug accumulation, and can realize deep drug accumulation through multi-cell immune-metabolic network regulation and control in tumor focus tissues. The immunosuppression microenvironment is relieved, and pancreatic tumors are inhibited.

column12: Preparation method of medicine auxiliary modified mannitol
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of mannitol preparation, and particularly discloses a preparation method of medicine auxiliary modified mannitol, the mannitol comprises the following components in parts by mass: 100-120 parts of mannitol, 5-10 parts of polyethylene glycol PEG, 2-5 parts of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose CMC-Na, 3-7 parts of cyclodextrin, 1-3 parts of nano silicon dioxide, 10-20 parts of plant source microcrystalline cellulose, and 1-5 parts of chitosan; through compound modification, the hardness and compressive strength of mannitol in the tablet are remarkably improved, the fragmentation phenomenon in transportation and storage is reduced, the integrity of the tablet is ensured, the powder fluidity is improved by adding nano silicon dioxide, and the plasticity of the preparation in industrial production is better; under the synergistic effect of cyclodextrin and chitosan, the dissolving property of mannitol is improved, so that the medicine disintegration is more uniform, and the preparation method is suitable for different dosage forms such as oral instant tablets and enteric sustained-release tablets; and the adjustability of the disintegration time after modification meets the diversified requirements from quick release to slow release.

column12: Rhodiola rosea nano-emulsion and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a rhodiola rosea nano-emulsion. The rhodiola rosea nano-emulsion comprises a rhodiola rosea extract, an interfacial agent, a co-interfacial agent and oil. The surfactant comprises diethylene glycol monoethyl ester or polysorbate 80, the co-surfactant comprises polysorbate 80, sorbitan oleate 80, or caprylic/capric polyethylene glycol glyceride, and the oil comprises medium chain triglyceride or soybean oil, and coats the rhodiola rosea extract in an oil-in-water manner. column12: Special long-acting coated controlled-release fertilizer for summer corn and preparation method of special long-acting coated controlled-release fertilizer
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural fertilizers, in particular to a special long-acting coated slow/controlled-release fertilizer for summer corn and a preparation method of the special long-acting coated slow/controlled-release fertilizer. The preparation method of the special long-acting coated slow/controlled-release fertilizer for summer corn comprises the following steps: (1) preparing modified corn straw biochar powder: crushing corn straws, heating and soaking the crushed corn straws in a mixed aqueous solution of NaOH and Na2SO3 and a hydrogen peroxide solution in sequence, carbonizing and grinding; (2) preparing a coating solution: mixing polyethylene glycol 400 and glycerol, heating, adding the modified corn straw charcoal powder and concentrated sulfuric acid, continuing heating, adding nano silicon dioxide, polyvinylpyrrolidone and an isocyanate curing agent, and uniformly mixing; (3) granulating; and (4) coating: spraying the coating solution to the surfaces of fertilizer granules obtained by granulation, and drying to obtain the special long-acting coated slow/controlled-release fertilizer for summer corn. The special long-acting coated controlled-release fertilizer for summer corn prepared by the preparation method is used for field experiments, and the harvested summer corn is good in quality and high in yield.

column12: Polyamino acid nano-drug carrier for responsive removal of polyethylene glycol, preparation method and nano-drug thereof
column13: The invention provides a polyamino acid nano-drug carrier for responsive removal of polyethylene glycol, a preparation method and a nano-drug thereof. The nano-drug carrier is loaded with an active drug component, and after entering a body, the nano-drug carrier can be passively targeted and accumulated at a tumor tissue by virtue of a blood long circulation effect and an EPR effect (the EPR effect means that a solid tumor tissue has the characteristics of high permeability and retention compared with a normal tissue) of polyethylene glycol. An environment with meta-acidity and high-concentration matrix metalloproteinase is arranged around a tumor tissue, and after a drug enters the tumor tissue, a connecting part of PEG and a glutamic acid unit has a response effect on the change of pH or matrix metalloproteinase concentration in a microenvironment around the tumor tissue and is broken, so that a polyethylene glycol structure is automatically removed, and the drug delivery efficiency is improved. The medicine without the polyethylene glycol can be more efficiently endocytosed by tumor cells, so that active medicine components are released, and the tumor cells are effectively killed.

column12: POLYPEPTIDE-MODIFIED LIPOSOME FOR TARGETED DRUG DELIVERY AND USE THEREOF

The polypeptide-modified lipid material is obtained by coupling a polypeptide to a lipid material containing a polyethylene glycol chain; the polypeptide is Cys-(X)n, wherein X is any one or any two of Arg, Asp, His, Glu or Thr, n is the total number of X and is an integer in the range of greater than 1 and less than 11; and the polypeptide is coupled to the polyethylene glycol chain by means of a thiol group on a cysteine residue of the polypeptide. The provided polypeptide-modified liposome can achieve targeted delivery of drugs to organs, tissue and cells in the body. The provided polypeptide-modified lipid material has a certain degree of universality, and can be used in combination with multiple currently commercially available liposome excipients; and the type of an ionized lipid material and the type of a phospholipid can be adjusted arbitrarily.

column12: Oral hydrogel for esophageal mucosa drug delivery and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides oral hydrogel for esophageal mucosa drug delivery and a preparation method and application thereof.The oral hydrogel comprises a first component and a second component, the first component is formed by dispersing polyethylene glycol, polyphenol, sodium alginate and drugs in water, and the second component is formed by dispersing polyethylene glycol, polyphenol, sodium alginate and drugs in water; the second component is formed by dispersing a thermo-sensitive polymer, a tackifier, a water-soluble calcium salt or a water-soluble zinc salt in water; the surface of the first component is covered with the second component, the water-soluble calcium salt or the water-soluble zinc salt reacts with the sodium alginate to convert the first component into a gel state, the first component can be adhered to the wound surface of the esophageal mucosa after being converted into the gel state, and the second component is converted into the gel state under the body temperature condition. column12: Responsive nano drug delivery system as well as preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of nano medicines, in particular to a response type nano drug delivery system as well as preparation and application thereof. The introduction of polyethylene glycol effectively improves the water solubility and biocompatibility of the liver protection drug silibinin, and at the same time, a drug-induced liver injury microenvironment can generate a large amount of active oxygen, the nano drug delivery system responsively degrades at an injury part, recovers quenched near-infrared two-region fluorescence, releases silibinin to exert anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidation curative effects, and has a good application prospect. The damaged liver is effectively identified, the problems of low drug loading rate, premature release, blood circulation leakage and the like in a physically coated nano drug delivery system are solved, and the specific diagnosis and treatment of the drug-induced liver injury are realized. The preparation method is simple and easy to implement and obvious in effect.

column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of dual-crosslinking ultrasonic response hyaluronic acid hydrogel, and belongs to the field of drug delivery, the preparation method comprises the following steps: taking hyaluronic acid as a raw material, and preparing hyaluronic acid dopamine through amidation reaction; then synthesizing a block polymer poly (polyethylene glycol metacrylic acid-co-4-vinyl phenylboronic acid) through a copolymerization reaction, mixing the block polymer poly (polyethylene glycol metacrylic acid-co-4-vinyl phenylboronic acid) with hyaluronic acid dopamine, dissolving the mixture in deionized water to obtain a mixed solution, preparing drug-loaded iron oxide nano magnetic microbubbles, adding the drug-loaded iron oxide nano magnetic microbubbles into the mixed solution to obtain a hydrogel solution, adjusting the pH value to 5-6, and standing to obtain the hydrogel. The problems that traditional single hyaluronic acid hydrogel is often insufficient in mechanical strength and elasticity are solved, and the prepared hyaluronic acid hydrogel has excellent mechanical strength and structural stability, can release drugs through ultrasound, has a good release effect, also has the characteristics of low toxicity and good biocompatibility, and can be used for preparing the hydrogel. The method has a good application prospect in the field of biological application.

column12: Nano-drug with photosensitive effect as well as preparation method and application of nano-drug
column13: The invention relates to a nano-drug with a photosensitive effect and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a mixed solution of trametinib, polyethylene glycol 400, purified water and poloxamer; performing normal temperature-low temperature freezing and thawing circulation; and centrifuging, washing and freeze-drying. According to the preparation method disclosed by the invention, by designing the raw material composition and utilizing a normal-temperature-low-temperature freeze-thaw cycle method, all the components can be stably combined together through hydrophilic-hydrophobic layer-by-layer self-assembly, a cross-linking agent does not need to be additionally introduced, and the obtained nano-drug has very strong pH stability; the effect of photothermal controlled release of chemical drugs is achieved, and the chemical drugs can be controlled to be released at tumor positions to treat tumors; the bismuth alkene/trametinib compound has high water-phase stability, and overcomes the defects that hydrophobic bismuth alkene and trametinib are insoluble in water and are difficult to disperse in water. The nano-drug provided by the invention can be used for preparing an anti-tumor preparation.

column12: Light-response self-degradation ultra-small mesoporous organosilicon drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a light-response self-degradation ultra-small mesoporous organic silicon drug delivery system as well as a preparation method and an application of the light-response self-degradation ultra-small mesoporous organic silicon drug delivery system. The preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide (CTAB) as a guiding agent, hydrolyzing an organic silicon source and an inorganic silicon source in an alkaline solution at room temperature to form silicon spheres, modifying polyethylene glycol on the surfaces of the silicon spheres, and dialyzing under an acidic condition to remove the guiding agent, so as to prepare the mesoporous silicon nanomaterial with the particle size of about 10-20nm and excellent water solubility. The method is simple in synthesis step, mild in reaction condition and concentrated in material particle size distribution.

column12: Bacteriostatic erection-assisting time-delay gel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a bacteriostatic erection-assisting time-delay gel, and belongs to the field of external medicines. The gel is prepared from the following components: glycerol, 1, 2-propylene glycol, ethanol, polyethylene glycol distearate, potassium polysaccharide sulfate, 4-(butylamino)-benzoic acid 2-(dimethylamino) ethyl ester and sustained release elements containing traditional Chinese medicine extracts. Wherein the sustained-release element takes fibroin nano-microspheres as a carrier, carries traditional Chinese medicine extracts of fructus cnidii, saffron crocus and salvia miltiorrhiza, and enhances blood circulation and local metabolism through a sustained-release mechanism. The gel in the technology realizes multiple effects of reducing sensitivity, prolonging sexual life time and improving local blood circulation through matching of the components and a slow release technology.

column12: Novel nanogel carrier cross-linked through ultraviolet light as well as preparation method and application of novel nanogel carrier
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and designs a redox-responsive nanogel carrier based on ultraviolet light induced crosslinking as well as preparation and application of the redox-responsive nanogel carrier. According to the carrier, hyaluronic acid is taken as a core, methoxy polyethylene glycol amino and diethylenetriamine are combined, and a DL-alpha-lipoic acid monomer is grafted through side chain amino. Under the irradiation of 365nm ultraviolet light, the polymer forms nanogel through ring opening polymerization (ROP). And the strained disulfide bond is sheared into double free radicals under the action of ultraviolet rays to trigger the polymerization of lipoic acid. The nanogel has excellent protein drug (such as cytochrome C) loading capacity, and can accurately target CD44 overexpressed tumor cells. After entering tumor cells, the carrier can rapidly escape from lysosome, controllable release of the medicine is realized under the action of glutathione (GSH), and the cancer cells are effectively killed. The invention provides a powerful nano platform for cancer protein therapy, and has a wide application prospect.

column12: Nano-drug delivery system capable of entering brain through nose and targeting central nervous system as well as preparation method and application of nano-drug delivery system
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly discloses a nano-drug delivery system entering brain through nose and targeting central nervous and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano-drug delivery system capable of entering the brain through the nose and targeting the central nervous system comprises a biological treatment drug and lectin coupled liposome nano-particles wrapping the surface of the biological treatment drug, the biological treatment medicine is mRNA (messenger ribonucleic acid) coded biological macromolecules; the lectin is AAL, and the raw materials of the lipidosome nanoparticles comprise SM102, DSPC (Distearoyl Pyrrolidone), cholesterol, DMG-pSar25 and DSPE-PEG-MAL (Distearoyl Pyrrolidone-Polyethylene Glycol). According to the invention, AAL and LNP with specific components are coupled, so that specific recognition and binding with receptor fucose of target cells are realized, nano-materials are helped to be endocytosed through olfactory mucosa and delivered to the brain through a nasal-brain pathway, biological treatment drugs are delivered in a targeted manner, the blood-brain barrier is broken through, and the targeting efficiency and nasal delivery efficiency are remarkably improved.

column12: Anticancer nano co-loaded drug compound as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anti-cancer nano co-loaded drug compound and a preparation method and application thereof.The anti-cancer nano co-loaded drug compound comprises a drug carrier obtained by conducting surface chemical modification on a zirconium-based metal organic framework material through boric acid groups and conducting co-doping on Cu ions and Mn ions, protoporphyrin and capecitabine are loaded on the drug carrier, the surface of the drug carrier is modified with phospholipid polyethylene glycol 2000; the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a boron affinity functional material; s2, preparing a drug carrier; and preparing the anticancer nano co-loaded drug compound. The anti-cancer nano co-loaded drug compound prepared by the preparation method is applied to the anti-tumor aspect. According to the invention, protoporphyrin, capecitabine, copper ions and manganese ions can be stably released in a cell microenvironment, and chemical kinetics-sonodynamic-chemotherapy combined therapy is realized.

column12: Multi-arm polyethylene glycol drug conjugate as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a multi-arm polyethylene glycol drug conjugate as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the multi-arm polyethylene glycol drug conjugate comprises the following steps: selecting multi-arm polyethylene glycol of which the molecular weight is 2000Da to 40000Da; in an anhydrous environment, multi-arm polyethylene glycol and 7-ethyl-10-hydroxycamptothecin are combined through a chemical coupling reaction. The invention further provides application of the multi-arm polyethylene glycol drug conjugate in preparation of drugs for treating pancreatic cancer. When the multi-arm polyethylene glycol drug conjugate is selected as a drug for treating pancreatic cancer, through a controlled release method of ultrasonic treatment, accurate positioning and drug release of pancreatic cancer tumors can be enhanced, the targeting and efficiency of treatment are improved, and a new treatment approach is expected to be provided for pancreatic cancer.

column12: Conjugated linoleic acid vesicle for preventing and treating alopecia and application of conjugated linoleic acid vesicle
column13: The invention discloses conjugated linoleic acid vesicles for preventing and treating alopecia and application of the conjugated linoleic acid vesicles. column12: Bioerodible cross-linked hydrogel implants and related methods of use
column13: The present disclosure is directed to a composite implant for the sustained release of a therapeutic agent from a hydrogel matrix. The hydrogel matrix may be a cross-linked bioerodible polyethylene glycol (PEG) hydrogel with a therapeutic complex dispersed within the cross-linked bioerodible PEG hydrogel. The therapeutic complex may include a therapeutic agent in association with mesoporous silica particles. The composite implant is configured to be delivered to or implanted into an eye of a subject or patient. The composite implant may be used treat ocular disease in a subject or patient. Ocular diseases may be selected from at least one of neovascular age related macular degeneration (AMD), diabetic macular edema, or macular edema following retinal vein occlusion.

column12: Multifunctional diagnosis and treatment integrated nano polymer carrier and application thereof in preparation of diagnosis and treatment agent for Citrus Huanglongbing
column13: The invention relates to a multifunctional diagnosis and treatment integrated nano polymer carrier and application thereof in preparation of a citrus liberobacter asiaticum diagnosis and treatment agent, and belongs to the field of prevention and treatment of citrus liberobacter asiaticum. The functional diagnosis and treatment integrated nano polymer carrier comprises a nano carrier, a diagnosis imaging agent, a Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum antibacterial agent and a Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum targeting fragment. The nano carrier is an amphiphilic polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer-polyethylene glycol-maleimide, and the nano carrier is an amphiphilic poly (lactic acid-glycolic acid) copolymer; the diagnostic imaging agent is fluorescent carbon dots; the Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum antibacterial drug comprises a hydrophobic drug and a hydrophilic drug. The Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum targeting fragment is an antibody Fab'fragment for identifying outer membrane protein of Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum. Citrus saplings are taken as research objects, and the multifunctional diagnosis and treatment integrated nano polymer carrier with antibody Fab'fragment targeted delivery, fluorescence tracing and drug sustained release is constructed and is used for researching the propagation process of Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum in the citrus saplings and inhibiting the propagation of the Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticum.

column12: Nano preparation for on-demand drug delivery for inherent barrier of pancreatic cancer and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and relates to a nano preparation for on-demand drug delivery for an inherent barrier of pancreatic cancer, and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano preparation is formed by coating silibinin with micelles prepared from polyethylene glycol-polyarginine-polylysine-nitroimidazole, carrying out electrostatic adsorption on gemcitabine monophosphate and coating hyaluronic acid. Wherein the polymer fragment can adsorb gemcitabine monophosphate through the electropositive property of polyarginine, the preparation utilizes the hydrophobic encapsulation effect to load an STAT3 inhibitor silybin, and hyaluronic acid is coated on the surface of the micelle in order to improve the cycling stability and tumor accumulation capacity of the micelle. The obtained nano preparation can penetrate through a compact tumor matrix, chemotherapy sensitization is achieved, ECM is remodeled, an immunosuppression microenvironment is reversed, and therefore the anti-tumor curative effect on PDAC is improved.

column12: Glycyrrhetinic acid chitosan self-healing hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly relates to glycyrrhetinic acid chitosan self-healing hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The hydrogel is prepared from glycyrrhetinic acid, chitosan and polyethylene glycol with benzaldehyde groups at two ends, in the hydrogel, a Schiff base bond serves as a connecting bridge, glycyrrhetinic acid is loaded in a physical mixing mode, and the hydrogel is used for intratumor injection. According to the invention, glycyrrhetinic acid is taken as a main drug, rich glycyrrhetinic acid receptors on the liver are taken as action targets, self-healing hydrogel is taken as a carrier, and a drug delivery system which is accurate in targeting and slowly releases drugs in vivo is constructed in an intratumor injection drug delivery mode. Meanwhile, the accumulation of glycyrrhetinic acid in a tumor lesion position is increased, the effectiveness of the medicine in a body is improved, some toxic and side effects caused by the medicine are reduced, and the purpose of inhibiting hepatocellular carcinoma is achieved. The invention provides thoughts and references for the design of a hydrogel targeting system, and provides a new method for clinical treatment of liver cancer.

column12: METHOD FOR PREPARING DOUBLE-CROSSLINKING ANTIBACTERIAL HYDROGEL DRESSING WITH CONTROLLABLE RELEASE OF GALLIUM IONS
column13: The present invention belongs to the technical field of medical biomaterial preparation. Disclosed is a method for preparing a double-crosslinking antibacterial hydrogel dressing with controllable release of gallium ions. The double-crosslinking antibacterial hydrogel dressing is prepared by means of using N-isopropylacrylamide, chitosan, polyethylene glycol diacrylate, an initiator and an accelerator as raw materials, and sequentially performing processes such as stirring, polymerization, freeze drying, and loading. The hydrogel dressing obtained in the present invention can sensitively realize high-temperature rapid controlled release and low-temperature slow controlled release of gallium ions and has a significant antibacterial performance. The hydrogel dressing has mechanical flexibility similar to that of the skin, and can fit well to wounds covering large joints such as the knees and ankles. In addition, the hydrogel dressing has good water absorption and swelling properties, which helps to absorb tissue fluid exuding from the surface of a wound. The preparation method of the present invention is simple, has mild process conditions, and has prominent application prospects regarding wound infection healing.

column13: An oral dosage form of metformin and preparation method is provided. column12: Bifunctional slow-release nano-drug delivery system with ROS responsiveness and application of bifunctional slow-release nano-drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine and pharmacology, and particularly relates to a difunctional slow-release nano drug delivery system with active oxygen responsiveness and application of the difunctional slow-release nano drug delivery system. The drug delivery system is composed of two parts, in one part, mesoporous silica is used for loading vitepofen, the surface of the mesoporous silica is wrapped with polydopamine to form PMSN-VP nano particles, in the other part, phenylboronic acid functionalized polylactic acid-glycolic acid-polyethylene glycol copolymer is used for wrapping cerium oxide quantum dots to form PPCeO2NPs, and in the other part, the PPCeO2NPs is used for coating cerium oxide quantum dots. The two parts are connected through a boric acid ester bond formed by a phenolic hydroxyl group on the surface of the PDA and a phenylboronic acid group on the PBA. According to the invention, PMSN-VP NPs can down-regulate factors related to angiogenesis and exert an anti-angiogenesis function, PPCeO2NPs can down-regulate expression of proinflammatory factors and exert an anti-inflammatory function, and meanwhile, a borate bond can be broken in an ROS environment, so that the drug delivery system is endowed with a responsive drug release capability.

column12: Injectable photothermal hydrogel based on melanin, preparation method, and application thereof
column13: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide an injectable photothermal hydrogel based on melanin and a preparation method and an application thereof. The injectable photothermal hydrogel is a hydroxypropyl chitosan/bis-amino polyethylene glycol modified melanin nanoparticles (HPCS/MP) hydrogel. The HPCS/MP hydrogel is prepared by mixing bis-amino polyethylene glycol modified melanin nanoparticles (MP) with hydroxypropyl chitosan (HPCS). The MP is synthesized by an amidation reaction of the melanin and the bis-amino PEG. A ratio of a volume of an MP solution to a volume of an HPCS solution in the HPCS/MP hydrogel is 4:6. A concentration of the MP solution is 20 wt %. A concentration of the HPCS solution is 4 wt %.

column12: PREPARATION METHOD AND APPLICATION OF A TARGETED PEPTIDE MODIFIED NANODRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM (PDC) WITH SPECIFIC BINDING TO THE NEUROTENSIN RECEPTOR (NTR)

column12: Slow-release amoxicillin capsule and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a sustained-release amoxicillin capsule and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing an amoxicillin nano-drug; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving poly L-lactic acid and a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer in dichloromethane, and adding an amoxicillin nano-drug to obtain a layer of polymer coated particles; dissolving poly (D-lactic acid) in dichloromethane, and adding a layer of polymer to wrap the particles to obtain a double-layer particle-in-oil suspension; magnesium aluminum silicate sol is prepared, the titanium dioxide nanoparticles and polyethylene glycol are added into the magnesium aluminum silicate sol, and gel titanium dioxide nanoparticles are obtained; adding water into the gel titanium dioxide nanoparticles to obtain a water suspension, and dripping the double-layer particle-in-oil suspension into the water suspension to obtain a nanosuspension/double-layer particle-in-oil composite emulsion; transferring the composite emulsion into curing liquid to obtain amoxicillin microspheres; and filling the microspheres to obtain the amoxicillin capsule. column13: Disclosed is a method for preparing microparticles for drug delivery. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a mold layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a first release characteristic at a first condition. The method comprises loading the compartments coated with the mold layer with a pharmaceutical composition comprising a drug substance. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a top layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a second release characteristic at the first condition for provision of closed microparticles in the multiple individual compartments. The method comprises separating the closed microparticles by cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges. By cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges discrete microparticles are provided.

column12: Nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines and nano preparations, and particularly relates to a nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs. The nano motor is composed of a nano carrier, a ferroptosis drug and an ultrasonic enhancer. Polyethylene glycol (PEG) modified polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) nanoparticles are preferably selected as the nano-carrier, gambogic acid is preferably selected as the ferroptosis drug, and perfluorobromooctane is preferably selected as the ultrasonic enhancer. The nanomotor is prepared by a nanoprecipitation method or a microfluidic method. The materials are simple and easy to obtain, the preparation operation is simple and convenient, the prepared nano motor has excellent high intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) response performance, deep driving and efficient accumulation towards a focus part can be realized under the action of HIFU, and controllable release of a medicine at a tumor part is realized. Meanwhile, the nano motor can cooperate with HIFU to enhance the ferroptosis effect of tumor cells, activate the anti-tumor immune effect of the body and inhibit the growth and metastasis of tumors.

The nanocomplex has a disease repair effect and can carry drugs, which are delivered to cerebrovascular lesion site.

column12: Andrographolide-loaded targeted nano drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to an andrographolide-loaded targeted nano drug delivery system as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Comprising the following steps: (1) adding poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)-polyethylene glycol and andrographolide into acetone, ultrasonically dissolving, and filtering to obtain an oil phase O; (2) adding thiamine pyrophosphate into a PBS (Phosphate Buffer Solution), and continuously adding fucoidin into the thiamine pyrophosphate solution to obtain a water phase W; and (3) injecting the oil phase O into the water phase W, emulsifying and stirring, and then filtering, ultra-filtering, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain the andrographolide-loaded targeted nano drug delivery system. According to the andrographolide-loaded targeted nano drug delivery system provided by the invention, the concentration of andrographolide at an inflammation part is effectively improved and the half-life period is prolonged by utilizing the combination effect of fucoidin and a macrophage surface receptor, so that the drug effect is more remarkable, and the purpose of enhancing the anti-inflammatory function of andrographolide is achieved.

column12: 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation as well as preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation as well as a preparation method and application of the 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation. A nanocrystal of 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britannolactone (OABL) is rapidly formed in water by utilizing a solvent exchange strategy, and a metal-polyphenol polymer shell layer formed by self-assembling tannic acid and iron ions is rapidly formed on the surface of the OABL nanocrystal based on the biological adhesion characteristic of polyphenol and a polyphenol-metal interface self-assembling process, so that the metal-polyphenol polymer shell layer is formed. The stability of the OABL nanocrystal is effectively improved; the preparation method comprises the following steps: assembling metal-polyphenol and OABL nanocrystals by using a nano coprecipitation method, and modifying polyethylene glycol phospholipid modified transferrin receptor specific peptide (DSPE-PEG-T7) with a brain-targeting delivery effect to the surface of a multi-effect nano preparation, so as to realize the preparation of the brain-targeting multi-effect nano preparation of OABL. The multi-effect nano preparation of OABL provided by the invention has multiple activities of resisting neuroinflammation, resisting oxidative stress and the like, is beneficial to realizing the purpose of drug combination, can effectively deliver OABL to the brain and remarkably improve the bioavailability of the brain, and can be used for preparing a multi-effect nano drug for treating Alzheimer's disease.

column12: Antithrombogenic coatings

The anti-thrombogenic coating comprises one or more peptides configured to interact with fibrinogen in the blood, such as a first type of peptide configured to bind to fibrinogen and a second type of peptide configured to inhibit conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin. The anti-thrombogenic coating further comprises a polymer, such as a hydrocolloid polymer, tunable polyethylene glycol (PEG), or other controlled release polymer, configured to control release of the one or more peptides and maintain a concentration of the peptides at a surface of the anti-thrombogenic coating above a minimum inhibitory concentration, thereby inhibiting thrombin formation on an intravascular medical device.

column12: Ultrasonic responsive hydrogel and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, in particular to ultrasonic responsive hydrogel and application thereof. The invention provides an ultrasonic responsive hydrogel prepared by crosslinking 4-arm hydroxylamine polyethylene glycol, oxidized dextran and diselenide bond hydroxylamine polyethylene glycol. The invention also provides a pharmaceutical composition and a vaccine which are prepared from the ultrasonic responsive hydrogel. According to the ultrasonic responsive hydrogel provided by the invention, cross-linked grids are formed through reaction under mild conditions, and various drugs or protein antigens can be encapsulated in the gel; the ultrasonic responsive hydrogel has good shear thinning performance and can be subjected to local muscle/subcutaneous injection, so that in-vivo long-acting slow release or controllable release of drugs or protein antigens is realized, and the problems that the drugs or the protein antigens are released too fast in vivo, vaccines need multi-needle injection, and immunization is still not lasting are effectively solved; the method has a wide application prospect in the aspects of maintaining the effective antigen concentration in vivo, reducing the administration frequency and difficulty and the like.

column12: EXTENDED RELEASE DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR OCULAR DRUGS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Described herein are therapeutic compositions and methods of use, for the delivery of various drug substances, in and around the eye, comprising: a drug substance, noncovalently interacting with one or more complexation agent particulates to form drug substance-complex particulates, admixed within a hydrophobic dispersal medium, that collectively forms a stable multiphasic colloidal suspension, that serves as an extended release drug delivery system for ocular drug delivery. Formulation of the drug substance in the multiphasic colloidal suspension can be administered in and around the eye to produce sustained release of therapeutic levels of drug substance within ocular tissues for one or more months without requiring retreatment.

column12: INTRAVITREAL MITOCHONDRIAL-TARGETED PEPTIDE PRODRUGS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Described herein are therapeutic compositions for the treatment of mitochondrial disorders, and in particular mitochondrial disorders of the eye, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). In particular, described herein are prodrugs of mitochondrial targeted tetrapeptides that have a cleavable covalent bond (e.g., an ester bond) to a conjugation moiety, wherein the conjugation moiety of the prodrug noncovalently complexes with one or more complexation agents to form drug-complex particulates with a defined avidity, and one or more drug-complex particulates are added to and dispersed within a dispersal medium forming a multiphasic colloidal suspension that serves as an extended release drug delivery system for ocular drug delivery. This extended release drug delivery system may be injected or inserted into the eye (e.g., vitreous) to reverse and prevent mitochondrial dysfunction in the eye for one or more months without requiring retreatment.

The method includes steps of: a) mixing water, meglumine, PEG-600, and glycerin till clear to obtain the first mixture; and b) mixing sodium polyacrylic acid salt, dihydroxyaluminium amino acetate, and sodium carboxymethyl cellulose till uniform to obtain a first clear solution and adding the clear solution to the first mixture to obtain a second mixture; c) heating purified water in a vessel and then adding gelatin, pvpk-90, and d-sorbitol powder into the water to obtain a second clear solution, then adding and mixing tartaric acid, titanium dioxide, and kaolin light powder into the second clear solution and cooling the bulk to obtain third mixture; d) adding the second mixture to third mixture and mixing them till uniform viscous gel appears to obtain a solution; and e) dragging the solution on a backing membrane to obtain sheet.

column12: Near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of biomedical materials. The near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch comprises a bonding layer and a plurality of microneedles arranged on the bonding layer in an array mode, and drug hydrogel is loaded in the microneedles; wherein the microneedle comprises polyethylene glycol and soluble polysaccharide; the drug hydrogel comprises a temperature-sensitive material, a polymer gel material and a drug. The microneedle prepared from the polyethylene glycol and the soluble polysaccharide has enough hardness and can easily penetrate through the cuticle without pain; the drug hydrogel loaded in the microneedle can be continuously and controllably released, the effectiveness of controlled release of epidermal drugs can be prolonged, and the treatment effect is achieved; besides, the adhesive layer can be firmly adhered to the skin and is prevented from falling off in the movement process, so that the near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch has a good application prospect in transdermal drug delivery.

column12: Adriamycin-loaded microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, and discloses doxorubicin-loaded microspheres and a preparation method thereof. An existing drug carrier loaded with melanoma chemotherapeutic drugs is small in drug loading capacity and cannot meet the requirements for skin repair of melanoma operation prognosis, prevention of diffusion of focus cancer cells and the like. In order to solve the technical problems, various drug loading systems are comprehensively researched, and then the doxorubicin-loaded microspheres are provided, the melanoma chemotherapeutic drug doxorubicin is loaded through the microspheres with graphene oxide, polyethylene glycol and chitosan as main components, the large drug loading ratio and stability can be achieved, and the drug loading efficiency is improved. The preparation method is suitable for long-acting release of adriamycin. The drug loading rate of doxorubicin loaded on the microspheres provided by the invention can reach 40.1%-60.0%.

column12: Sugar lipid molecule, drug delivery carrier, drug compound and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a sugar lipid molecule, a drug delivery carrier, a drug compound and application thereof, and relates to the field of biological medicine and material chemistry. The compound has a structure as shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, deuterated substance or prodrug thereof. The saccharide lipid molecule of # imgabs0 can replace PEG (polyethylene glycol) lipid, and a novel and efficient LNP delivery system is constructed. After the sugar lipid molecule replaces PEG lipid and is added into a basic LNP system, an original liver-targeted LNP delivery system can be converted into a spleen-targeted LNP delivery system. According to the delivery system, the charge size and hydrophobicity can be regulated and controlled in a great range by changing the length of a carbohydrate chain and the variety and number of hydrophobic chain segments, and nucleic acid molecules can be efficiently delivered.

column12: Preparation method and evaluation method of docetaxel NLC delivery system
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to a preparation method and an evaluation method of a docetaxel NLC delivery system. Comprising the following steps: weighing 5mg of docetaxel, 80mg of palmitate palmitate and 45mu l of caprylic capric triglyceride, dissolving the docetaxel, the palmitate palmitate and the caprylic capric triglyceride with ethanol, placing the solution in a water bath kettle at 60 DEG C for a proper time, and volatilizing the ethanol to enable the solution to reach a molten state to serve as an oil phase for later use; dSPE-PEG2000-r9, DSPE-PEG2000-r9, DSPE-PEG2000-iNGR, soya bean lecithin and 75mg of polyethylene glycol-15 hydroxy stearate are taken and mixed, then 5ml of normal saline is added, ultrasonic dissolution is performed, and the mixture is placed in a constant-temperature heating magnetic stirrer at 60 DEG C to serve as a water phase for standby application. R9/iNGR-DTX-NLC is constructed, meanwhile, the penetrating ability of the medicine to tumor cell membranes and tumor tissues is improved, the anti-tumor ability is improved, and the application prospect is wide. The r9/iNGR-DTX-NLC applies a related mechanism, and the cell-penetrating peptide r9 can effectively penetrate through a cell membrane barrier, so that the drug delivery efficiency is improved.

column12: Gemcitabine nano prodrug with stable circulation as well as preparation method and application of gemcitabine nano prodrug
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano drug delivery, and particularly relates to a gemcitabine nano prodrug with stable circulation as well as a preparation method and application of the gemcitabine nano prodrug. The nano prodrug comprises a delivery carrier and a gemcitabine prodrug with coupling activity, the delivery carrier is a polyethylene glycol polyamino acid block copolymer, and the gemcitabine prodrug with coupling activity is a prodrug molecule formed by coupling 6-maleimide hexanoic acid or dibenzocyclooctynoic acid with gemcitabine; the nano prodrug polymer is prepared into stable drug-loaded micelles, vesicles or nanoparticles through a dialysis method, a film hydration method or a nano precipitation method. The nano prodrug based on polyethylene glycol polyamino acid carrier coupled gemcitabine is clear in structure, simple and convenient to synthesize and stable in circulation, the in-vivo anti-tumor effect is obviously superior to that of a prototype drug, the toxicity is lower, and the nano prodrug has the effects of precise tumor targeting, long-acting and long-lasting in tumor and accurate positioning killing.

column12: Bionic nano-carrier for crossing blood brain barrier and application of bionic nano-carrier
column13: The invention discloses a bionic nano-carrier for improving blood brain barrier crossing efficiency by taking lysosome escape as a strategy. column12: Temperature-responsive polymer based on polyethylene glycol and preparation method thereof
column13: The preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking polyethylene glycol of which the double terminals are hydroxyl or amino and carboxyl-containing polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon as raw materials and 1-ethyl-(3-dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride, 4-dimethylaminopyridine and triethylamine as a catalytic system, reacting at the temperature of 20-30 DEG C for 80-120 hours, and separating and purifying to obtain the temperature-responsive polymer based on polyethylene glycol. column12: Method for realizing active controlled release and slow release of bioactive molecules and drug application
column13: The invention discloses a method for realizing active controlled release and slow release of bioactive molecules and drug application. At present, many protein or polypeptide drugs have the problems of short half-life period, frequent administration, large fluctuation of blood concentration, poor safety and the like, and particularly, clinical application is limited due to remarkable toxic and side effects of direct administration of IL-2 and other drugs. In the prior art, polyethylene glycol is usually used for modifying a medicine to prolong the physiological half-life period of the medicine and reduce the immunogenicity and toxic and side effects of the medicine, but the biological activity of the medicine modified by PEG is obviously reduced, and the effective release and bioavailability of the activity of the medicine in vivo are not ideal. According to the invention, a PEG modifier with a specific structure is screened through various experimental designs and repeated verification, and the PEG modifier can be widely used for active controlled release and slow release of various bioactive molecules. Particularly, the PEG modifier with the specific type and structure reacts with IL-2 to form a conjugate, under certain in-vitro conditions or in-vivo physiological conditions, the effects that PEG gradually falls off from the conjugate and the activity of IL-2 is gradually released are achieved, a certain effective blood concentration of bioactive molecules can be maintained, and the bioavailability is improved. The active sustained release and controlled release of the drug in vivo and in vitro are realized, the dynamic balance of better drug bioavailability and safety can be achieved, and the drug delivery frequency is reduced, the drug bioavailability is improved, the patient compliance is better, the safety is better, and other clinical application prospects are achieved.

The non-aqueous injectable composition includes one or more biocompatible non-aqueous solvents, one or more release retarding agents, one or more surfactants, one or more biodegradable polymers and one or more stabilizers. The buprenorphine composition of the present invention delivers buprenorphine over a period of about one week to 12 weeks after single administration which leads to better patient compliance by reducing the daily dose administration of buprenorphine. The present invention also provides an injectable composition with potentially less pain due to the use of smaller gauge needles wherein the suitable gauge of needle may be 23 gauge to 30 gauge with a length of 8 to 30 mm. column12: COMPOSITION FOR PREVENTING AND/OR TREATING RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND APPLICATION THEREOF
column13: The present invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicine, and particularly relates to a composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis as well as a preparation method and an application thereof. The composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is prepared from the following raw material components in parts by mass: 10 to 40 parts of Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, 15 to 120 parts of Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae, 15 to 60 parts of Radix Astragali, 5 to 30 parts of Radix Paeoniae Alba, 3 to 15 parts of Herba Ephedrae, 3 to 15 parts of Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata, 5 to 30 parts of Radix Morindae Officinalis, and 5 to 30 parts of Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata. Clinical experiments have proved that the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis according to the present invention can improve symptoms of ankle swelling and pain of patients, and control the levels of inflammation and disease progression, and has a potential effect of protecting bones. [0001] The present invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicine, and particularly relates to a composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis as well as a preparation method and an application thereof.BACKGROUND ART[0002] Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a common autoimmune disease. Its pathological characteristics are manifested as synovial inflammation and synovial tissue proliferation of joints. Bone destruction, as an important feature of RA joint damage, mainly includes the damage and destruction of articular cartilages and bones. The problem of disability caused by bone destruction in RA patients in China is still severe, where a disability rate is up to 43.5% in the course of 5 to 10 years, and 90% in the course of 30 years. Bone destruction caused by the inflammatory hyperplasia of the synovial joints is a core pathological link of rheumatoid arthritis, so how to effectively block bone destruction and reduce the disability rate is a difficulty to be urgently overcome in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.[0003] Although Western medicine treatment regimens can effectively control pathogenetic conditions in the short term, they are still not completely effective in stabilizing the conditions in the long term, especially in stopping the imago!ogical progression (i.e., stopping a process of bone destruction). Disease-modifying antirheumatic dnigs (DMARDs) such as methotrexate (MTX) are first-line therapeutic dntgs for RA. Early, adequate and combined use of DMARDs is the key to improve the prognosis of RA. However, 40% of patients have no response to early induction remission regimens. In addition, DMARDs are greatly limited, even resisted by patients, in long-term clinical applications due to their side effects such as gastrointestinal symptoms, bone marrow suppression, hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, infections, tumors and autonomic neuropathy, and poor tolerability. Although new DMARDs such as biologies continue to make progress, there are still problems such as rapid short-term efficacy, unstable long-term efficacy, easy recurrence of patients' conditions, and incompletely clear safety due to a single -target effect, and high treatment price of biologies in China has brought a heavy economic burden to individual patients and society. At present, DMARDs, including the biologies, cannot effectively block or inhibit the pathological process of articular bone destruction in RA patients, resulting in a continuous progression of imagological changes under treatment.[0004] RA falls under a category of "arthralgia syndromes" in traditional Chinese medicine. Classic prescriptions such as Radix Astragali and Ramulus Cinnamomi Five-drug Decoction (including Radix Astragali, Ramulus Cinnamomi, Paeonia Lactitlora, Rhizoma Zingiberis Recens and Fructus Jujubae) or a Ramulus Cinnamomi, Paeonia Lactiflora and Rhizoma Anemarrhenae Decoction (including Ramulus Cinnamomi, Paeonia Lactiflora, Radix Glycyrrhizae, Herba Ephedrae, Rhizoma Zingiberis Recens, Rhizoma Atractylodis Macrocephalae, Rhizoma Anemarrhenae, Radix Saposhnikoviae and Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata) have been used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, but their treatment effects are not very satisfactory'. In addition, the Chinese patent application with publication No. CN108578606A discloses a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, which consists of 35 parts of Radix Astragali, 15 parts of Ramulus Cinnamomi, 25 parts of stir-fried Radix Paeoniae Alba, 10 parts of Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata, 15 parts of Radix Angelicae Sinensis, 25 parts of Semen Coicis, 15 parts of Radix Saposhnikoviae, 15 parts of Radix Gentianae Macrophyllae, 10 parts of Rhizoma Et Radix Notopterygii, 10 parts of Rhizoma Chuanxiong, 15 parts of Rhizoma Atractylodis, and 15 parts of Radix Glycyrrhizae, and has a certain therapeutic effect on rheumatoid arthritis, but whether it can block or inhibit the pathological process of joint bone destruction in RA patients still needs to be further explored.SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION[0005] According to an aspect of the present invention, a composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is provided. The composition is prepared from the following raw' material components in parts by mass: 10 to 40 parts of Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, 15 to 120 parts of Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae, 15 to 60 parts of Radix Astragali, 5 to 30 parts of Radix Paeoniae Alba, 3 to 15 parts of Herba Ephedrae, 3 to 15 parts of Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata, 5 to 30 parts of Radix Morindae Officinalis, and 5 to 30 parts of Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata.[0006] The traditional Chinese medicine composition of the present invention is used for activating blood circulation and tonifying kidney, and expelling cold and dispelling wind and dampness as a therapeutic method, mainly for patients with syndromes of cold dampness and stasis, and is specifically described as follows.[0007] Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae and Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae are used as sovereign drugs. Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae has the efficacy of activating blood circulation and remove stasis, and removing blood stasis to engender the new blood. Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae has the efficacy of activating blood circulation and removing meridian obstruction, and dispelling wind and eliminating dampness.[0008] Radix Astragali, Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata and Radix Morindae Officinalis are used as minister drugs. Radix Astragali assists the sovereign drugs in strengthening body resistance, and strengthening the effects of replenishing Qi and activating blood circulation, and has the efficacy of further strengthening body resistance when used together with Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae. Radix Morindae Officinalis is distributed to liver and kidney meridians, has the efficacy of nourishing liver and kidney, and strengthening the bones and muscles, and achieves double effects when used together with the sovereign drugs and Radix Astragali. Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata has the efficacy of expelling wind and cold and relieving pain, and assists the sovereign drugs in removing meridian obstruction.[0009] Radix Paeoniae Alba and Herba Ephedrae are used as assistant drugs. Radix Paeoniae Alba is used for assisting Radix Astragali to achieve the efficacy of nourishing blood and liver, and balancing the dryness of Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata, Herba. Ephedrae is used together with the sovereign drugs to assist in dispelling wind-dampness toxic evil, and relieving pain.[0010] Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata is used as a courier drug, and is used for coordinating the drug actions of the traditional Chinese medicine composition,[0011] In this prescription:[0012] Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae is dried roots and rhizomes of Salvia miltiorrhiza Bunge, that is a plant of the Labiate, Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae is bitter in flavor and little cold in nature, is distributed to heart and liver meridians, and has the efficacy of removing stasis and relieving pain, activating blood circulation and removing meridian obstruction, and clearing away the heart-fire and eliminating vexation.[0013] Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae is medicinal parts, i.e., rhizomatous roots, of Dioscorea nipponica Makino that is a plant of the Dioscoreaceae. Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae is bitter in flavor and bland in nature, and has the efficacy of relaxing muscles and acti vating collaterals, and dispelling wind and relieving pain.[0014] Radix Astragali is dried roots of Astragalus membranaceus (Fisch.) Bge. var. mongholicus (Bge.) Hsiao or Astragalus membranaceus (Fisch.) Bge. that is a plant of the Legume. Radix Astragali is sweet in flavor and warm in nature, is distributed to lung and spleen meridians, and has the efficacy of invigorating Qi for strengthening superficies, promoting diuresis to expel toxins and pus, and healing sores and prompting tissue regeneration.[0015] Radix Paeoniae Alba is dried roots of Paeonia lactiflora Pall, that is a plant of the Ranunculaceae. Herba Ephedrae is pungent, little bitter in flavor and warm in nature, is distributed to lung and bladder meridians, and has the efficacy of inducing sweating and dissipating cold, freeing lung to relieve asthma, and inducing diuresis to alleviate edema.[0017] Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata is a processed product of daughter roots of Aconitum carmichaeli Debx. that is a plant of the Ranunculaceae. Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata is pungent, sweet in flavor, great hot in nature and poisonous, is distributed to heart, kidney and spleen meridians, and has the efficacy of recuperating depleted Yang and rescuing patient from collapse, supplementing fire to support Yang, and expelling wind, cold, dampness and evil.[0018] Radix Morindae Officinalis is dried roots of Morinda officinalis How that is a plant of the Rubiaceae. Radix Morindae Officinalis is sweet, pungent in flavor and little warm in nature, is distributed to kidney and liver meridians, and has the efficacy of tonifying kidney Yang, strengthening muscles and bones, and expelling wind-dampness.[0019] Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata is a perennial herb of the Leguminosae and Glycyrrhiza, and is prepared by processing medicinal parts, i.e., roots and rhizomes, of Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata with honey and boiling w'ater. Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata is sweet in flavor and bland in nature, has mild properties that allow' it to be an upfloating medicinal and a downsinking medicinal, and is distributed to heart, lung, spleen and stomach meridians. Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata can tonify middle-Jiao and Qi, and also facilitates harmonizing the properties of various drugs.[0020] In some embodiments, the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is prepared from the following raw material components in parts by mass: 30 parts of Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, 30 parts of Rhizoma Dioscoreae Nipponicae, 30 parts of Radix Astragali, 10 parts of Radix Paeoniae Alba, 6 parts of Herba Ephedrae, 10 parts of Radix Aconiti Lateralis Preparata, 10 parts of Radix Morindae Officinalis, and 15 parts of Radix Glycyrrhizae Preparata.[0021] According to another aspect of the present invention, a method for preparing the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is provided. The method includes: crushing, sieving and mixing the components respectively to obtain the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis.[0022] According to another aspect of the present invention, an application of the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is provided. [0023] According to another aspect of the present invention, a traditional Chinese medicine preparation is provided, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine preparation uses the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis as an effective constituent.[0024] hi some embodiments, the traditional Chinese medicine preparation further includes the medically acceptable accessory. Preferably, the accessory is at least one of a sustained-release agent, an excipient, a filler, a binder, a wetting agent, a disintegrant, an absorption promoter, an adsorption carrier, a surfactant and a lubricant. For example, the sustained-release agent and the excipient may be water. The filler may be starch and sucrose. The binder may be a cellulose derivative, alginate, gelatin and polyvinylpyrrolidone. The wetting agent may be glycerol. The disintegrant may be agar, calcium carbonate and sodium bicarbonate. The absorption promoter may be a quaternary ammonium compound. The adsorption carrier may-be kaolin and bentonite. The surfactant may be cetyl alcohol. The lubricant may be talc, calcium/magnesium stearate, or polyethylene glycol. In addition, a flavoring agent, a sweetener or other accessories may also be added.[0025] A dosage form of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation according to the present invention may be a decoction, a tablet, a capsule, a pill, a powder, a granule, a syrup or other conventional Chinese medicine dosage forms.[0026] According to another aspect of the present invention, an application of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis is provided.[0027] CIA rat model experiments have proved that the composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis according to the present invention can obviously alleviate a ankle swelling degree of CIA rats, X-ray shows that the composition can improve bone destruction, and a pathological section shows that the composition has good effects of inhibiting synovial tissue proliferation, reducing inflammatory cell infiltration and delaying bone and cartilage destruction. column12: Targeting nano anti-aging agent based on mesoporous polydopamine as well as preparation method and application of targeting nano anti-aging agent
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a targeting nano anti-aging agent based on mesoporous polydopamine. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) constructing polydopamine-TMPDA with mesopores as a carrier by applying Tempo improvement and PEG (Polyethylene Glycol) modification methods; (2) according to pi-pi stacking or hydrogen bond interaction, a water-soluble TMPDA carrier is used for wrapping hydrophobic mixed type Senlytics, namely, dasatinib and quercetin (D + Q); and 3) coating the mesoporous nanoparticles with a layer of galactan which can be decomposed by beta-galactosidase in a hydrogen bond adsorption manner, and finally obtaining the GTMPDA (at) D + Q. The multifunctional nano anti-aging agent constructed by the invention has the advantages of aging cell specific targeting, drug sustained release, high bioavailability, good biological safety and the like. Through intravenous injection, senescent alveolar type II epithelial cells can be efficiently removed, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis can be relieved; or the PTT photothermal therapy is combined to remove senescent tumor cells induced by chemotherapy and prevent tumor recurrence and metastasis.

column12: LONG-ACTING PARATHYROID HORMONE
column13: The invention provides a long-acting parathyroid hormone peptide (PTH) that is retained in a subject's blood serum for periods of time that greatly exceed the natural hormone. The long-acting PTH is conjugated to at the carbon 3 position of a non-hormonal vitamin D via a scaffold of discreet length that facilitates its purification, detection, solubility, and efficacy at the PTH receptor (PTHR). The PTH may be conjugated to the non-hormonal vitamin D via a 36 mer poly(ethylene glycol) moiety (PTH-PEG36-VitD). The invention also provides optimized manufacturing methods and formulations. The PTH-PEG36-VitD has a vastly-improved serum half-life and bioavailability when compared to a non-conjugated PTH peptide. PTH-PEG36-VitD also significantly increases serum calcium, reduces urinary calcium, and reduces serum phosphate.

column12: Preparation method of temperature-sensitive fly-luring ketone nano slow-release agent
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a temperature-sensitive type fly-luring ketone nano slow-release agent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, taking 0.5 mL of fly-luring ketone, adding the fly-luring ketone into 10mL of 60% acetonitrile-water solution, and uniformly mixing the fly-luring ketone and the 60% acetonitrile-water solution; s2, adding 1.000 g of polyethylene glycol 10000, carrying out ultrasonic treatment for 10 minutes, then adding 0.001 g of carboxylated multi-walled carbon nanotubes, carrying out ultrasonic dispersion for 30 minutes, and carrying out sealed standing for 12 hours; s3, 1.000 g of N-isopropylacrylamide, 0.02 g of N, N '-methylenebisacrylamide and 50 [mu] L of tetramethylethylenediamine are sequentially added, and stirring is carried out for dissolution; s4, introducing nitrogen for 30 minutes to remove oxygen in the system; s5, 0.04 g of ammonium persulfate is added, nitrogen is continuously introduced until the ammonium persulfate is completely dissolved, sealing is conducted, reaction is conducted for 12 h at the room temperature, and preparation is completed. According to the method, the temperature-sensitive type fly-luring ketone nano slow-release agent is researched and developed with fly-luring ketone as a raw medicine, MWCNTs-COOH as a carrier and PNIPAM hydrogel as an'on-off 'for controlling release of the attractant, so that controlled release of fly-luring ketone is achieved, the use cost of the attractant is reduced, and the economic benefits of the attractant are improved. And a theoretical basis is provided for monitoring, prevention and control of the fruit fly pests.
